name: The Shadowhound only hunts a stealthed player its Witch Hunter detects
contract: Pets use their owner's stealth detection, but a unit in combat with a stealthed player ignores the stealth, so a Shadowhound fighting a player kept chasing them after they stealthed.
The hounds now hunt a stealthed player only while their Witch Hunter detects them. The Shadowhound fights a PvP-flagged player thirty yards from its owner. When the player enters Stealth 1787

and the owner cannot detect them, the hound drops them at once (before the fix it kept them as its victim). With Invisibility and Stealth Detection 18950 (aura 17, +100000) on the owner, it keeps them.

steps.label: Let login and class synchronisation settle
Send the Shadowhound at the player
SETUP: the Shadowhound fights the player
DISCRIMINATING: the owner cannot detect the player, so the Shadowhound drops them
Fixture: the Witch Hunter detects stealth
Send the Shadowhound at the player again
SETUP: the Shadowhound fights the player again
Give the hound time to drop a target it may not hunt
The owner detects the stealthed player, so the Shadowhound keeps them
